name: WinClip
description:
A Windows-style clipboard manager. Super+V opens an overlay at the pointer, over whatever window you are in.

• Clipboard — text and image history, with pinned entries kept at the top
• GIF — GIFs you have copied, favourites, and animated GIFs found in your Downloads and Pictures folders
• Emoji — searchable by name and keyword, with pins, recents and a skin tone setting
• Kaomoji — text faces such as the shrug and Lenny
• Symbols — currency, arrows, maths, punctuation and Greek

Choosing an entry pastes it straight into the window underneath. Requires Wayland.
